literal_meaning: শিকে (কোনো পাতা বা টিকিটের মতো জিনিস) ছিঁড়ে ফেলা
figurative_meaning_en: Fortune being favorable or good luck prevailing
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় সে শিকে ছেঁড়া পেয়েছে, সব প্রশ্ন সহজ ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: My fortune tore the shike in the lottery; I won big.
She got lucky in the exam; it was like her fate tore the shike with easy questions.
note: The idiom likely originates from the imagery of tearing a lucky slip or leaf in traditional games or lotteries, symbolizing favorable chance.
